name: Campus Activewear Ltd
title: Campus Activewear Ltd - 543523 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue +12.3% to INR 456 cr with EBITDA margin 19.2% and PAT margin 9.6%, but FY26 inventory days rose 5-6 and management says price hikes were taken to cover raw-material inflation with no capacity constraint.

capex.quote: So we don't see FY26 like CAPEX spends in FY27.

triggers.label: Price hikes taken across range from April
triggers.quote: we took timely calibrated price actions across the entire range to safeguard margins

triggers.label: Sneaker capacity target 8-9 lakh pairs/month
triggers.quote: we are targeting in totality 8-9 lakh pair monthly production of sneakers

triggers.label: Peers slowing production
triggers.quote: there have been signs in the industry with respect to slowing down of production

triggers.label: FG inventory rebuilt after deferred correction
triggers.quote: that is the right level of inventory to sustain the kind of growth

guidance.value: 30-35 new stores (60-70 or about 80 mentioned earlier in answer)
guidance.quote: we expect to open anywhere between 60 to 70 stores or about 80 stores
we will definitely endeavor to stay within the range we have guided before, 17% to 19%

guidance.value: ~2 lakh pairs monthly, doubling by end FY27
guidance.quote: likely to double by end of FY27

red_flags.label: Inventory days up 5-6 days in FY26
red_flags.quote: if I see the inventory days, it has increased by approximately 5 to 6 days

red_flags.label: Lease cash outflow inflated by Pantnagar land
red_flags.quote: the cash outflow is shown as a payment of lease liability

evasions.quote: I would not like to diverge into numbers
we haven't done, honestly, a detailed study on market share post the IPO
